claim: Tourist arrivals fell from 2,333,796 in 2018 to 1,913,702 in 2019, an 18.0% annual decline after the Easter attacks disrupted the sector.

metric.denominator: international tourist arrivals recorded by SLTDA
metric.source_definition: tourist arrivals, not receipts, GDP contribution, employment or foreign-exchange earnings

bounded_by: 2019 is used as a control case for a severe tourism shock under different fiscal and financing conditions; it is not perfectly comparable to 2020–2022.
